Liam Zhang: Offer accepted for Backend Eng (IC4). Candidate asks to start May 2 but has prebooked honeymoon May 10-21 overseas. Can benefits start May 2?
Tasha Rivera: Paste comp and location.
Liam Zhang: Base $148,000; sign-on $10,000 split 50/50; Band IC4 (B-IC4-US); Location: Remote - CA
Megan Fox: IC4 midpoint 150k, this is slightly below midpoint. No uplift required. Manager can approve start date.
Payroll Bot: Benefits effective on official start date. Sign-on split OK; payroll needs ticket with signed offer and payment schedule to process.
Tasha Rivera: Proposed flow: set official start = May 2 so benefits effective then; record approved PTO May 10-21. Liam confirm candidate ok with benefits starting May 2 and first sign-on tranche on that date.
Liam Zhang: Confirmed with candidate. They accept May 2 official start and first sign-on on that date. I'll open payroll ticket and attach signed offer.
Megan Fox: Approving sign-on split and start date; onboarding plan: remote orientation May 2-9, async materials during PTO.
Liam Zhang: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
